children: Terra Property Trust’s third-quarter revenue declined from a year earlier as lower interest income, reflecting a smaller performing loan balance and suspended accruals on another non-performing loan, outweighed real estate and other income. The net loss widened, with operating losses and weaker results from unconsolidated investments contributing, partly offset by lower credit-loss provisions and reduced expenses.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Loss per share — basic and diluted”.
: Five loans across five states had $89.3M in net principal and a 12.7% weighted-average coupon at quarter-end.
: Net investments were $2.1M, compared with $2.0M in the prior-year quarter.
: The quarter’s $0.1M provision primarily reflected a lower estimated recovery on a non-performing subordinated loan.
: The company owned one industrial building and one multifamily property at September 30, 2026.
